decision.decision: Keep the correctly qualified combined attention baseline. Shift the next broad investigation to the linear projection and recurrent pipeline, whose completed core plus separate preceding projections dominate this profile. Inspect shared exact-replay arithmetic and opportunities to fuse the linear input transformations while preserving original rounding boundaries; choose a complete operator experiment before another product integration.
